title: Two Numbers One Frequency
style: Dark synthwave and boom-bap hybrid at 92 BPM with a steady head-nod bounce and clipped kick-snare pocket; verse rides tense bass and glassy synth stabs, pre-chorus strips to filtered pulse and handclaps, chorus opens with stacked hook doubles and gang ad-libs. QR-scan glitches, short risers, and a tape-stop between sections. Wide, punchy, nocturnal mix with a clean low end., theme, clean
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
One line for the biz
One line for the soul
Keep the tabs apart
Let the clean one roll
Scan the QR once
Then you let it breathe
Server in the dark
While the people sleep

[Pre-Chorus]
Don’t cross that wire
Don’t blur that flame
Keep the names in lanes
Keep the roles the same
Public stays outside
Dashboard stays sealed
Private by design
That’s the real deal

[Chorus]
Two numbers, one frequency
Business on the left, Corey on the right
VDS running twenty-four seven
Phone just checks in every fourteen nights
Two numbers, one frequency
Don’t merge the accounts, keep the signal clean
Tailscale locked, nobody gets in
Personal stays personal, business stays business

[Verse 2]
Headless in the rack
No hand on the wheel
The engine keeps moving
Quiet, sharp, and real
If the week gets wild
If the day runs long
The tunnel stays private
And the thread stays strong
One lane for work
One lane for home
No messy overlap
No mixed-up phone

[Pre-Chorus]
Don’t cross that wire
Don’t blur that flame
Keep the names in lanes
Keep the roles the same
Public stays outside
Dashboard stays sealed
Private by design
That’s the real deal

[Chorus]
Two numbers, one frequency
Business on the left, Corey on the right
VDS running twenty-four seven
Phone just checks in every fourteen nights
Two numbers, one frequency
Don’t merge the accounts, keep the signal clean
Tailscale locked, nobody gets in
Personal stays personal, business stays business

[Bridge]
Headless machine
Human on free
Built for the load
Not the noise in between
If they want the map
They only see the mist
If they want the door
It never exists

[Final Chorus]
Two numbers, one frequency
Business on the left, Corey on the right
VDS running twenty-four seven
Phone just checks in every fourteen nights
Two numbers, one frequency
Don’t merge the accounts, keep the signal clean
Tailscale locked, nobody gets in
Personal stays personal, business stays business
